items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Osie O. G. was so whipped that night. I think he had been hanging out, too.

ctx.x: Osie O. G. was so whipped that night. I think he had been hanging out, too. He went to sleep up there before the date. He laid down out there in the control room. And so then I said, "Okay." So we went to Junior's and she ordered my food for me and saw that my food was right. And so that night I took her to her pad where she lived and I didn't even kiss her goodnight or nothing because I didn't want her to think that I, you know, I wasn't trying to be forward or fresh or nothing. I had that much respect. I liked…
Well, you're that kind of guy, Butter.
